tool.name: IMAGINE-X SubHKL Diffraction Parallax (NOVA Interactive)
tool.description: Interactive Laue zone & Lattice-Ladder solve explorer with NDIP workflow orchestration
tool.command: export JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu && #set $p_opt = "" #if $indexed_h5: ln -sf "$indexed_h5" input_peaks.h5 && #set $p_opt = " input_peaks.h5 " #end if #set $img_opt = "" #if $images_h5: ln -sf "$images_h5" input_images.h5 && #set $img_opt = " --images input_images.h5 " #end if python -m subhkl.io.parser rainbow-visualize $p_opt $img_opt --instrument "$instrument" -o "$rainbow_html" --serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8081

param.name: indexed_h5
param.label: Solved / Indexed / Integrated SubHKL HDF5 (solve.h5, indexer.h5, integrator.h5)

tool.help:
**SubHKL Diffraction Parallax (NDIP / Galaxy / NOVA Interactive Tool)**
Launches an interactive web session (proxied via Galaxy's `entry_points` on port 8081) with: - **Coarse NDIP Workflow Pipeline Bar** (`Reduce & Merge` -> `Solve (Lattice Ladder)` -> `Predict & Integrate` -> `Merge & MTZ`) coupled to `nova-galaxy` via `$GALAXY_URL`, `$GALAXY_API_KEY`, and `$HISTORY_ID`. - **Step 1–5 Solve Lattice Ladder** that lights up during the `Solve` step. - **Cylindrical (`CG4D`) & Spherical (`MANDI`) Projections** with 2-layer depth parallax over log-scaled detector pixel intensities.
